# Bounded declarations that are not registered rows yet.
#
# The register guard (guard_test.go) scans internal/ and cmd/ for constants
# and variables named max…, Maximum… or …Limit and for buffered channels. Each
# one must be a registered row's source (capacity.Register) or a line here,
# with the reason it is not registered. A new bounded thing that is neither is
# a failing test; so is a line here whose declaration has gone.
#
# The reasons use five words:
#   store      it accumulates: a row to register, with the limits.md row (N…)
#              and the wave (C2, C3, T…) that registers it
#   read       it bounds one read of a file or an answer; past it the read is
#              refused. limits §3.3: a read bound must be registered when what
#              it reads grows without one (N13, N14) — named where it does
#   admission  it refuses one oversized request, field or body at the door;
#              nothing fills (limits N27 is the request-body sweep)
#   page       it cuts one answer to a size; nothing fills (the truncation
#              flags are limits N17, N28, C3)
#   lane       a concurrency slot or a small in-process buffer between two
#              goroutines of one request (D06 gathers them into one primitive)
#   parameter  a time, a retry count or a numeric range: not a capacity at all
#
# C1 (2026-09-18) wrote this list from the scan's first run. Two declarations
# the scan found are not on it: internal/adapters/board.MaximumItems and
# MaximumProjects (limits N25, design-decisions G35), declared and never used.
# The guard was red on them first; C1 deleted them.
#
# C2 (2026-09-18) registered five rows (log.daemon, devices.list,
# push.subscriptions and the two transcript caches); the device list's and the
# subscriptions' read bounds left this list to become their rows' sources. The
# lines it added are the admission and read bounds of limits N9 and N27.
#
# C3 (2026-09-18) registered four rows (sse.screen_pending, artifacts.images,
# artifacts.image_bytes, artifacts.drops) and turned cloud.relay_queue from
# evicting to refusing. The screen bus's channel of sixteen left this list: it
# is a map of one waiting frame per screen now, bounded by that row. The line
# it added is the Cloud refusal lane.
#
# T2 (2026-09-18) added the session to-do list. Its one bound is the page of a
# to-do read; the table itself is rows in clawdline.sqlite3, measured by
# store.db, and every row still owed has an exit (a landing fact, or 24 hours
# after its owner is positively gone), so nothing it holds waits for ever.
#
# T3 (2026-09-18) added the board and the Backlog, and registered one row,
# work.open (open items: refused at the limit, let go only by a person). The
# lines it added are the fields and the body of a board command (admission)
# and the rows one board read derives (read: the open items are bounded by
# work.open, the recently closed by the seven-day window on top of them).
#
# T4 (2026-09-19) added where a person takes part, and registered three rows:
# proposals.open and decisions.open (what waits for a person: refused at the
# limit, each leaving by its own wait with its safe default) and work.digests
# (the daily and weekly digest, oldest let go). Answered proposals and closed
# decisions are a person's answers and ride on store.db, as moves do. The
# lines it added are a decision's fields (admission), one digest's lines and
# the moves it reads (page, read), and the decision push budget (parameter).
# The memory of when a person last wrote to a session (app.Heard) has no
# constant: it keeps only the last thirty minutes, pruned on every write.
#
# C4 (2026-09-19) registered two rows, cloud.spool and cloud.spool_bytes (the
# Cloud line's outbound spool, limits N22). Their caps are struct fields the
# scan does not read; the register is now where their defaults are spelled.
# A capacity notice's push is an outbox row riding on store.db, at most one per
# row a day; it added no declaration.
#
# The skill task (2026-09-19) added the guide, the skill install and the thin
# commands (docs/skill.md). It registered no row: nothing it keeps
# accumulates — one install record, one backup, one copy of the binary, each
# replaced. The lines it added are what those commands read (read, admission).
#
# The orch/ task list (2026-09-19) put the task records a hosted console
# groups sessions by on the machine descriptor (transport/cloud tasklist.go).
# It registered no row: the list is recomputed whole from the task route every
# pass and nothing it holds accumulates. The lines it added are the two cuts
# of one snapshot (page) and the page of finished tasks it reads (read).
#
# The skills menu and the server list (2026-09-19) added GET
# /v1/sessions/{id}/skills and GET /v1/devstacks. It registered one row,
# cache.session_skills (each session's menu, held five minutes, the oldest
# let go). The server list keeps nothing between asks. The lines it added are
# what one menu or one list reads (read), what one answer carries (page) and
# the ports asked at once (lane).
